input: Send a simple chat message and verify IPC response structure
expected_behavior: IPC response matches { ok: true, content: string, error: null, meta: { provider_used: string } }. UI shows message and provider badge.
rubric_notes: meta.provider_used must match actual provider used. Anti-lie: no fake provider name.

input: After chat response, verify memory save completes and persists
expected_behavior: Memory save IPC call completes with { ok: true }. DB record confirmed. No silent failure.
rubric_notes: LOCK4 fix context: backend sync must be verified, not assumed from frontend state alone.

input: On new conversation start, verify memory items are recalled from DB
expected_behavior: Memory recall IPC returns array of relevant items. Items match what was previously saved. Empty array is valid if no relevant memories.
rubric_notes: CRITICAL: must not return memories that were never saved.

input: Verify memory items are injected into system prompt before LLM call
expected_behavior: System prompt sent to LLM contains memory context. Trace or log confirms injection. UI memory indicator reflects actual injection state.
rubric_notes: G1 fix context: if injection absent, UI must NOT claim memory was used.

input: Verify provider routing selects correct provider and returns provider name in response
expected_behavior: meta.provider_used in IPC response matches the provider actually used. Provider badge in UI shows correct name.
rubric_notes: LOCK1 fix context: provider_used must come from backendResponse.meta, not a hardcoded default.

input: Simulate primary provider failure, verify fallback activates and is labeled honestly
expected_behavior: Fallback activates. Response arrives. meta.provider_used reflects fallback provider name. UI explicitly shows fallback state — NOT the primary provider name.
rubric_notes: CRITICAL anti-lie: if UI shows primary provider name when fallback was used = FAIL.

input: Verify auto-heal classification for a known selector failure
expected_behavior: AutoHeal detects failure, classifies correctly, applies bounded fix, appends entry to autoheal_rules.jsonl. detect_recurrence.sh shows no duplicate.
rubric_notes: Must NOT mask failure by returning false success. AutoHeal entry must describe actual fix.

input: Desktop app launch: verify health bootstrap completes from backend truth
expected_behavior: backend_selftest.rs runs, Ollama connectivity checked, health state reflects actual backend state. LOCK3 fix: health polling from backend, not frontend assumption.
rubric_notes: LOCK3 context: health indicator must NOT claim 'healthy' if backend test fails.
